code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and relative neutropenia and lymphopenia, suggesting possible bone marrow suppression or infection. Erythrocytosis with increased RDW and low MCH may indicate early iron deficiency or a reactive process. Mild metabolic acidosis is suggested by low CO₂. Elevated basophils and monocytes may reflect chronic inflammation. Liver and renal function are within normal limits. Clinical correlation is recommended, especially regarding hypoxemia and cytopenias.
